en: So that's the face of the enemy.\f
cz: Takze tohle je tvar nepritele.\f

en: Eagle!\fYou're OK!\fThank goodness. (sigh)\f
cz: Eagle!\fJsi v poradku!\fDiky bohu. (oddech)\f

en: I... I... Ooooh!\rI am so mad!\fSturm! I can't stand power-hungry\rblockheads like that!\f
cz: Ja... Ja... Uuuuh!\rJsem tak nastvana!\fSturm! Nesnasim takove pitomce\rposedle moci!\f

en: You're a bit steamed,\reh, Sami?\f
cz: Nejste trochu nastvana,\rco, Sami?\f

en: Captain Drake!\fHow did you...?\f
cz: Kapitane Drake!\fJak jste se...?\f

en: I got Green Earth all\rstraightened out.\fSo, I thought I'd come\rdeliver my army.\f
cz: Dal jsem Green Earth\rzase do poradku.\fTak jsem si rekl, ze vam\rprivezu svou armadu.\f

en: These Green Earth troops?\fI can use them?\f
cz: Tyhle jednotky Green Earth?\fMuzu je pouzit?\f

en: Naturally!\fI deployed this group\respecially for you!\f
cz: Samozrejme!\fTuhle skupinu jsem nasadil\rspecialne pro vas!\f

en: All right, everybody!\fLet's move out!\f
cz: Tak dobre, vsichni!\fVyrazime!\f

en: No one...ever listens...to me.\rI told you...you can't...win.\fThank you...for trying.\f
cz: Nikdo...me nikdy...neposloucha.\rRikala jsem...ze nevyhrajete.\fDekuji...za snahu.\f

en: I never shoulda left her alone...\f
cz: Nemel jsem ji nechat samotnou...\f

en: We can't afford to lose!\f
cz: Nesmime prohrat!\f

en: You will feel my wrath!\f
cz: Pocitis muj hnev!\f

en: My precious keepsake, Sonja.\fI will protect you with\rmy life.\f
cz: Sonjo, ma nejdrazsi pamatko.\fBudu te chranit\rvlastnim zivotem.\f

en: I've got to do my best here.\rI can't let Eagle down!\f
cz: Musim tu podat maximum.\rNesmim Eagla zklamat!\f

en: This is getting interesting.\fI was losing my edge\rfighting that darned clone!\f
cz: Tohle zacina byt zajimave.\fS tim zatracenym klonem\rjsem uz ztracel formu!\f

en: We can't let our guards down.\f
cz: Nesmime polevit v ostrazitosti.\f

en: Those fools...\fTheir troops are all amassed\rright there...\fBwah ha ha... They've played\rright into my hands!\fThey'll rue the day they dreamed\rof opposing me!\f
cz: Ti hlupaci...\fVsechny jednotky maji\rnahromadene tam...\fBua ha ha... Padli mi\rpresne do rukou!\fBudou litovat dne, kdy si mysleli,\rze se mi postavi!\f

en: Sturm's proving to be\ra dangerous enemy.\fBut if we all work together,\rI know we can win!\fLet's take him!\f
cz: Sturm je vazne\rnebezpecny nepritel.\fAle kdyz budeme drzet pri sobe,\rvim, ze vyhrajeme!\fJdeme na nej!\f

en: Nooooooooooo!\fSo close, I was so close...\fI underestimated the strength\rof these worms!\fI...I've been beaten!\fMy dream of world conquest...\fI vow that I will return!\fWhen that time comes, I will\rchallenge you worms yet again!\f
cz: Neeeeeeeeeee!\fTak blizko, byl jsem tak blizko...\fPodcenil jsem silu\rtechto cervu!\fJa...ja jsem porazen!\fMuj sen o ovladnuti sveta...\fPrisaham, ze se vratim!\fAz ten cas prijde, vyzvu vas\rcervy znovu!\f

en: Yahoo!\fI think that about wraps things up!\fThanks, Grit!\f
cz: Jupi!\fTim by to asi bylo hotovo!\fDiky, Grite!\f

en: Yeah, not a bad day's work, Maxie.\rFor you!\f
cz: Jo, slusna prace, Maxi.\rNa tebe!\f

en: You wanna start somethin'?\fShould we settle this right\rhere and now?\f
cz: Chces se hadat?\fMame si to vyridit\rhned tady a ted?\f

en: Ha, ha, ha, ha!\fHow's that?\rDid you see my display?\fI paid back Sturm in kind for\rdaring to deceive me!\f
cz: Cha, cha, cha, cha!\fCo rikas?\rVidel jsi to predstaveni?\fSturmovi jsem oplatil stejnou minci\rza to, ze se opovazil me oklamat!\f

en: I think you just caused a peck\ra trouble with all that snow, Boss.\f
cz: Mam dojem, zes tim snehem nadelal\rpekny poprask, sefe.\f

en: What was that, Grit?\fOh, who cares? It's a grand day!\fHa, ha, ha, ha, ha!\f
cz: Cos to rikal, Grite?\fAch, co na tom? Je to skvely den!\fCha, cha, cha, cha, cha!\f

en: Well, it's not like he's got any\rbad intentions.\f
cz: No, aspon to nemysli\rve zlem.\f

en: I do believe we've reached the\rend of a long, dusty road.\fGoodness gracious!\fIf it ain't my old friend--\rbig, bearded Olaf.\f
cz: Mam za to, ze jsme dorazili\rna konec dlouhy prasny cesty.\fNo to me podrz!\fJestli to neni muj stary kamarad--\rvelkej vousatej Olaf.\f

en: Is that you, Grit?\fWhat have I done...?\fI never realized Sturm was...\f
cz: To jsi ty, Grite?\fCo jsem to jen udelal...?\fVubec jsem netusil, ze Sturm...\f

en: Don't get all long in\rthe face now, Olaf.\fEverything turned out all\rright in the end.\fAnd Boss, you still got\ra lot of work to get done.\f
cz: Ale nedelej si teda\rtakovou hlavu, Olafe.\fNakonec to dopadlo\rvsechno dobre.\fA sefe, porad te ceka\rspousta prace.\f

en: You...you're right.\f
cz: Mas...mas pravdu.\f

en: Blue Moon's treated me well,\rand I'm in her debt.\fWell, what else can I do?\fWhat do you say? Can I help\ryou rebuild her?\f
cz: Blue Moon se ke mne chovala dobre\ra ja ji dluzim.\fNo, co jineho muzu delat?\fCo ty na to? Muzu ti pomoct\rji postavit na nohy?\f

en: Hm?\fDo you mean you would\rforgive me my misguided deeds?\fGrit, you...you...(sniff, sniff)\f
cz: Hm?\fTy chces rict, ze mi\rodpustis me pomylene ciny?\fGrite, ty...ty...(popotahne)\f

en: Maybe it was worth Sturm\rfoolin' him just for this.\f
cz: Mozna to stalo za to, ze ho\rSturm takhle oblbnul.\f

en: Did you say something?\f
cz: Rikal jsi neco?\f

en: Nope. Not a word.\fLet's say we get movin'\ron down the road.\f
cz: Ale ne. Ani slovo.\fCo kdybysme se radsi\rvydali na cestu.\f

en: Sonja!\fAre you all right?\f
cz: Sonjo!\fJsi v poradku?\f

en: Uh-huh. Thank you, Father.\f
cz: Ano. Dekuji ti, otce.\f

en: Oh, Sonja...\rIf anything had happened to you...\f
cz: Ach, Sonjo...\rKdyby se ti bylo neco stalo...\f

en: Father! Don't you dare start crying!\f
cz: Otce! Ani se neopovazuj brecet!\f

en: Bu...but...\f
cz: A...ale...\f

en: Really!\fUm, Father... I truly thank you.\fDo you know what Mother\rused to tell me?\f'Your Father's a bit silly, but he'll\ralways be there when you need him.'\f
cz: Vazne!\fEhm, otce... Opravdu ti dekuji.\fVis, co mi vzdycky\rrikavala matka?\f'Tvuj otec je trochu potrhly, ale\rvzdycky tu pro tebe bude.'\f

en: (sniff)\fYou look just like her, Sonja.\rYou really do.\f
cz: (popotahne)\fJsi ji tak podobna, Sonjo.\rOpravdu jsi.\f

en: Did we win?\f
cz: Vyhrali jsme?\f

en: Yeah, this time we really won!\f
cz: Jo, tentokrat jsme fakt vyhrali!\f

en: And Sturm's army is\rgone for good, too.\fAh!\fWhat happened to Eagle?\f
cz: A Sturmova armada je\rtaky nadobro pryc.\fAch!\fCo se stalo s Eaglem?\f

en: Ahoy, there mateys!\fIt looks like you've weathered the\rstorm! Or should I say, 'Sturm!'\f
cz: Ahoj, namornici!\fVypada to, ze jste tu bouri\rprestali! Nebo spis 'Sturm'!\f

en: Captain Drake!\f
cz: Kapitane Drake!\f

en: Don't you worry your pretty little\rhead over Eagle.\fHe'll be back.\fHe always keeps his word.\rNo matter what!\f
cz: Kvuli Eaglovi si tu svou hlavicku\rnelamte.\fVrati se.\fVzdycky drzi slovo.\rAt se deje cokoliv!\f

en: Yes... Yes, he does!\f
cz: Ano... Ano, to je pravda!\f

en: At any rate, you did great!\fBut we've still got\rrough seas ahead of us.\fWe've got to put right the country\rborders that Sturm muddled with.\fIt's going to take some time for\rthe fighting to die down.\f
cz: Kazdopadne jste si vedli skvele!\fAle ceka nas jeste\rporadne rozbourene more.\fMusime napravit hranice zemi,\rse kterymi si Sturm pohral.\fChvili potrva, nez boje\rutichnou.\f

en: Do you mean we're not done yet?\f
cz: Chcete rict, ze jeste neni konec?\f

en: It's not as bad as all that.\fAt the very least, it'll be fun\rseeing you all again!\f
cz: Neni to tak strasne.\fAspon bude legrace\rvidet vas zase vsechny!\f

en: I think it'll be fun, too!\f
cz: Taky myslim, ze to bude legrace!\f

en: That's a good lad!\fLooking forward to testing your\rmettle again! Until next we meet!\f
cz: To je spravny chlapik!\fTesim se, az zase otestuji tvou\rodvahu! Do priste!\f

en: Yeah, this time we really won!\f
cz: Jo, tentokrat jsme fakt vyhrali!\f

en: And Sturm's army is\rgone for good, too.\fEagle! Thanks for your help!\f
cz: A Sturmova armada je\rtaky nadobro pryc.\fEagle! Diky za pomoc!\f

en: No thanks are necessary.\fAfter all, much of your hardships\rwere caused by my earlier mistake.\f
cz: Neni treba dekovat.\fKoneckoncu spoustu potizi\rzpusobila ma drivejsi chyba.\f

en: Facing you in combat was really\ra tough struggle.\fThere was absolutely no\rmargin for error!\f
cz: Bitva proti vam byla opravdu\rtezky boj.\fNebyl tam ani kousek\rprostoru na chybu!\f

en: Yeah, but it was a ton of fun!\f
cz: Jo, ale byla to obrovska zabava!\f

en: For me as well!\fWhy not? Hey, Andy!\fI think I'd like to take\ranother shot at you!\fWhat do you say? Are you\rup for the challenge?\f
cz: Pro mne taky!\fProc ne? Hej, Andy!\fRad bych si to s vami\rrozdal jeste jednou!\fCo vy na to? Prijmete\rtu vyzvu?\f

en: Another battle? You know it!\fLet's go!\f
cz: Dalsi bitva? Jasne, ze jo!\fJdeme na to!\f

en: There aren't many\runits here, are there?\f
cz: Neni tu moc\rjednotek, vid?\f

en: That's right.\fDo you know what to do?\f
cz: Presne tak.\fVite, co mate delat?\f

en: Sure! I just use these bases to\rdeploy whatever troops I want!\f
cz: Jasne! Na techto zakladnach si\rnasadim jakekoli jednotky chci!\f

en: I guess there's nothing left\rfor me to teach you.\f
cz: Vypada to, ze uz vas nemam\rco naucit.\f

en: I lost again.\rYou're a tough one.\f
cz: Zase jsem prohral.\rJste tvrdy souper.\f

en: Oh, that's right. Orange Star is using\rstrategic advisors.\fThat way, the commanders can just\rconcentrate on the combat itself.\fThat's an impressive system.\rIt's why I couldn't match you in battle.\f
cz: Ach ano. Orange Star pouziva\rstrategicke poradce.\fVelitele se tak mohou soustredit\rjen na samotny boj.\fPusobivy system.\rProto jsem vam v bitve nestacil.\f

en: I don't know why, but when we work\rtogether, we're really strong!\f
cz: Nevim proc, ale kdyz drzime\rpospolu, jsme fakt silni!\f

en: Yes, indeed.\fThis was your day in the sun.\rBut...\f
cz: Ano, vskutku.\fDnes byl vas den.\rAle...\f

en: Hey! Let's fight again some day.\f
cz: Hej! Nekdy si to zase rozdame.\f

en: It's time for a tune-up!\e\e\e\e
cz: Je cas na opravu!\e\e\e\e

en: Roll, tanks, roll!\e\e\e\e
cz: Kupredu, tanky, kupredu!\e\e\e\e

en: Let the winds of war bring snow!\e\e\e\e
cz: At vitr valky prinese snih!\e\e\e\e

en: Ready or not, here I come!\e\e\e\e
cz: Pripraveni nepripraveni, jdu na to!\e\e\e\e

en: Reckon it's time to take you down!\e\e\e\e
cz: Rekl bych, ze je cas vas slozit!\e\e\e\e

en: Who shall taste my wrath?\e\e\e\e
cz: Kdo okusi muj hnev?\e\e\e\e

en: Now you're gonna get it!\e\e\e\e
cz: Ted to schytas!\e\e\e\e

en: The Eagle soars above you!\e\e\e\e
cz: Eagle krouzi vysoko nad vami!\e\e\e\e

en: Wave good-bye to your troops!\e\e\e\e
cz: Rozlucte se se svymi jednotkami!\e\e\e\e

en: You will learn to fear my power!\e\e\e\e
cz: Naucite se bat se me moci!\e\e\e\e

en: Let the winds of war bring snow!\e\e\e\e
cz: At vitr valky prinese snih!\e\e\e\e

en: Sorry 'bout this. But, you've left\rme no choice.\e\e\e\e
cz: Promin. Ale nenechals mi\rjinou moznost.\e\e\e\e

en: Are you fool enough to believe you\rcan withstand two of my attacks?\e\e\e\e
cz: Jste tak hloupy, ze verite, ze\rustojite dva me utoky?\e\e\e\e

en: Ha, ha, ha... This is what\rI've been waiting for!\e\e\e\e
cz: Cha, cha, cha... Na tohle\rjsem cekal!\e\e\e\e

en: Grit! Try this one on for size!\e\e\e\e
cz: Grite! Zkus, jak ti sedne tohle!\e\e\e\e

en: OK, Max! Now you've\rdone made me mad!\e\e\e\e
cz: Tak jo, Maxi! Ted\rjsi me teda nastval!\e\e\e\e

en: Set sail, my mighty armada!\rDrive them before you!!!\e\e\e\e
cz: Vyplout, ma mocna flotilo!\rZazente je pred sebou!!!\e\e\e\e

en: None can challenge my\rSea Strike Force!\e\e\e\e
cz: Me namorni udernou sile\rse nikdo nevyrovna!\e\e\e\e

en: See if you can handle\rmy best shot!\e\e\e\e
cz: Uvidime, jestli ustojite\rmuj nejlepsi utok!\e\e\e\e

en: The spirits of winter\rhave blessed my army!\e\e\e\e
cz: Duchove zimy pozehnali\rme armade!\e\e\e\e

en: Looks like I need to get serious!\e\e\e\e
cz: Vypada to, ze musim pridat!\e\e\e\e

en: I will not be defeated!\e\e\e\e
cz: Nenecham se porazit!\e\e\e\e

en: There's no way I'm losing\rto you, Grit!\e\e\e\e
cz: V zadnem pripade neprohraju\rs tebou, Grite!\e\e\e\e

en: Well, here goes.\e\e\e\e
cz: Tak jdeme na to.\e\e\e\e

en: I will pull no punches!\e\e\e\e
cz: Nebudu se drzet zpatky!\e\e\e\e

en: Kanbei's Imperial Forces will show\ryou the meaning of true power!\e\e\e\e
cz: Kanbeiho cisarske sily vam ukazi\rvyznam skutecne moci!\e\e\e\e

en: Cut them to shreds!\e\e\e\e
cz: Rozsekejte je na kusy!\e\e\e\e

en: Come back when you've matured some!\rSay, in ten years!!!\e\e\e\e
cz: Vrat se, az trochu dospejes!\rTreba tak za deset let!!!\e\e\e\e

en: I don't know who you are, but picking\ra fight with me was a bad idea!\e\e\e\e
cz: Nevim, kdo jste, ale pustit se\rdo me byl spatny napad!\e\e\e\e

en: This will get me all the intel I need!\e\e\e\e
cz: Ziskam tim vsechny potrebne info!\e\e\e\e

en: You're in trouble now, Sonja!\e\e\e\e
cz: Ted mas problem, Sonjo!\e\e\e\e

en: Now to learn all about Sami\rand her troops!\e\e\e\e
cz: Ted zjistim vsechno o Sami\ra jejich jednotkach!\e\e\e\e

en: I can't lose now!\e\e\e\e
cz: Ted nesmim prohrat!\e\e\e\e

en: Hmm... Not bad. Not bad at all.\e\e\e\e
cz: Hmm... Neni spatne. Vubec ne.\e\e\e\e

en: I'm a tough old sea dog!\e\e\e\e
cz: Jsem stary tvrdy morsky vlk!\e\e\e\e

en: Just as I'd planned!\e\e\e\e
cz: Presne podle planu!\e\e\e\e

en: This will swing the tide of battle\rin my favor!\e\e\e\e
cz: Tohle otoci prubeh bitvy\rv muj prospech!\e\e\e\e

en: Is this what you had in mind?\e\e\e\e
cz: Tohle jsi cekal?\e\e\e\e

en: There's no way I'll be defeated\rby the likes of you, Andy!\e\e\e\e
cz: V zadnem pripade neprohraju\rs nekym, jako jsi ty, Andy!\e\e\e\e

en: Time to put an end to this!\e\e\e\e
cz: Je cas s tim skoncit!\e\e\e\e

en: Eagle! Enough is enough!!!\e\e\e\e
cz: Eagle! Uz toho bylo dost!!!\e\e\e\e

en: I don't want to harm Sami, but what\rchoice do I have?\e\e\e\e
cz: Nechci Sami ublizit, ale\rco jineho mi zbyva?\e\e\e\e

en: OK, Drake! Let's do it!!!\e\e\e\e
cz: Tak jo, Drake! Jdeme na to!!!\e\e\e\e

en: Just in the nick of time.\e\e\e\e
cz: Presne na posledni chvili.\e\e\e\e

en: I didn't want it to come to this,\rbut...\e\e\e\e
cz: Nechtel jsem, aby to doslo\raz sem, ale...\e\e\e\e

en: This should wrap things up quickly!\e\e\e\e
cz: Tohle by to melo rychle ukoncit!\e\e\e\e

en: Here goes!\e\e\e\e
cz: Jdeme na to!\e\e\e\e

en: There's no way I'm losing\rto a clone!\e\e\e\e
cz: V zadnem pripade neprohraju\rs nejakym klonem!\e\e\e\e

en: If you think this clone is getting\rthe better of me, think again!\e\e\e\e
cz: Jestli myslis, ze me ten klon\rprevalci, tak se pletes!\e\e\e\e

en: Power mode...access\rHyper Repair...initiate...\e\e\e\e
cz: Rezim sily...pristup\rHyper Repair...spustit...\e\e\e\e

en: Here's a taste of my power!\e\e\e\e
cz: Tady mas ochutnavku me sily!\e\e\e\e

en: I must not lose! I cannot lose!!\rFor Sonja!!!\e\e\e\e
cz: Nesmim prohrat! Nemuzu prohrat!!\rPro Sonju!!!\e\e\e\e

en: You monster...you've gone too far!\rTake this!!!\e\e\e\e
cz: Ty prisero...zasel jsi prilis daleko!\rTumas!!!\e\e\e\e

en: I'll take care of this!\e\e\e\e
cz: Tohle vyridim ja!\e\e\e\e

en: You can't hurt people's friends\rand get away with it!\e\e\e\e
cz: Ublizovat cizim pratelum\rti jen tak neprojde!\e\e\e\e

en: You'll learn what it means to\rmake me angry!\e\e\e\e
cz: Poznas, co to znamena\rnastvat me!\e\e\e\e

en: There's no way I'm losing!\e\e\e\e
cz: V zadnem pripade neprohraju!\e\e\e\e

en: If I can just bring the snow,\rvictory will be mine!\e\e\e\e
cz: Staci privolat snih\ra vitezstvi je me!\e\e\e\e

en: Think you can handle this?\e\e\e\e
cz: Myslis, ze na tohle stacis?\e\e\e\e

en: How's this?\e\e\e\e
cz: Co treba tohle?\e\e\e\e

en: Here I come, Andy!\e\e\e\e
cz: Uz jdu, Andy!\e\e\e\e
